{{Top|leg}}
The '''G0-T0 targeting module''' was specifically developed for the droid [[G0-T0]]. It was composed of an auxiliary processor that provided exceptional ranged combat abilities.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, only G0-T0 is able to equip this item.
